newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World's flats sale 106 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: New World's flats sale 106 times oversubscribed.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd's latest flat sale in Discovery Park in the New Territories was 106 times oversubscribed, the company said on Wednesday.
New World initially planned to release 98 flats in the development. Another 298 units were added last Thursday in view of strong response and 268 more on Tuesday.
The average price of the latest batch of 268 units has been raised by six percent to HK$5,000 per sq. ft., compared with HK$4,700 for the first two batches of a total 397 units.
Discovery Park, a joint venture development with HKR International Ltd, comprises 12 high rise residential towers and a 466,000 sq. ft. commercial centre in Tsuen Wan.
The flats range in size from 593 to 848 sq. ft.
The units will go on sale on September 20.
